subject: [RFC PATCH 09/57] mm/collapse: collect candidate windows into a round

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch adds a feature to collect candidate windows into rounds, which are batches of memory that can be collapsed together. The size of each round is capped at 32MB due to memory allocation and fault latency considerations. A dense table is collapsed as multiple rounds rather than one. The patch introduces new macros to define the maximum number of candidates per round and the batch size. It also updates the collapse_anon_pmd function to collect candidates into a round until it's full or selection is complete, then run the round and repeat the process.
